continuity: Yohi's Western Yao Estate was devastated, with more than a hundred Yao warriors and beasts dead and no survivors located.
The attacker was a Supreme Peak master whose swift, precise use of Force indicated extensive killing experience.
Jin and Yayul Mok concluded that Dark Heaven had directly intervened, probably by deploying at least one of its Supreme Peak masters, but the motive remains unknown.
Heugung visited Yohi with four guards shortly after parting from Jin; the guards were killed, and a severed wrist believed to be Heugung's was found, but his death is unconfirmed.
Faint footprints showed that a third party intervened and that the incident was not a staged attack by Heugung or Yohi; at least three people had been present.
Yohi disappeared from her estate, leaving behind a nearly scentless pouch as a possible clue.
Baeksang arrived before the Beast Miao King and said that the guilty party was coming out on their own; the person he meant remains unidentified.
plot: Yohi's Western Yao Estate was attacked by an unidentified Supreme Peak master who used Force to swiftly slaughter more than a hundred Yao warriors and beasts; no survivors had been found. Jin and Yayul Mok concluded that Dark Heaven had directly intervened and likely mobilized a Supreme Peak master, while faint footprints indicated that a third party had abducted Yohi and Heugung rather than the attack being their staged conflict.

Heugung had visited Yohi shortly after parting from Jin with four guards, all of whom were killed. A severed wrist believed to be Heugung's was found beside Yohi's nearly scentless pouch, but his death remained unconfirmed. Baeksang arrived before the Beast Miao King and declared that the guilty party was coming out on their own, revealing that the only known Supreme Peak masters in Nanman were not limited to Baeksang and the Beast Miao King.
translation_decisions: Retain Force for 강기, Supreme Peak for 초절정, and Sound Transmission for 전음.
Render 서요부 as Western Yao Estate and 동이부 as Eastern Yi Estate.

active_continuity: Jin remains in the Nanman Beast Palace's Inner Palace as the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and head of the Fire Dragon Pavilion.
The Fire Dragon Pavilion was attacked after Jin left, and Dark Heaven is suspected of organizing or enabling the assault.
Yohi's Western Yao Estate was attacked by a Supreme Peak master, killing more than a hundred Yao warriors and beasts.
Jin and Yayul Mok believe Dark Heaven directly intervened and likely deployed a Supreme Peak master, but the motive is unknown.
Baeksang and the Beast Miao King are the only two known Supreme Peak masters in Nanman.
Heugung genuinely loves Yohi and had promised to cooperate with Jin.
Heugung visited Yohi with four guards, who were killed; a wrist believed to be his was found, but his death is unconfirmed.
Faint footprints indicate that a third party abducted or confronted Heugung and Yohi rather than the incident being their staged attack.
Yohi and Heugung remain missing from the Inner Palace.
Yohi's nearly scentless pouch remains a possible clue.
Baeksang arrived before the Beast Miao King and declared that the guilty party was coming out on their own.
open_questions: Who was the Supreme Peak attacker, and what did Dark Heaven seek by intervening directly?
Are Heugung and Yohi alive, and where were they taken?
What can be learned from Yohi's nearly scentless pouch?
Who was Baeksang accusing when he said the guilty party was coming out on their own?
Is Baeksang truly colluding with Dark Heaven despite the evidence of third-party intervention?
temporary_decisions: Render 서요부 as Western Yao Estate and 동이부 as Eastern Yi Estate.
